global_rules.goal_order: Order is irrelevant only when explicitly listed as independent.
global_rules.task_success: All required goals must be completed and final answer must pass separate semantic review.
global_rules.alternative_sequences: Accept every sequence explicitly listed for the task.
global_rules.secrets: Never include original credentials or live tokens in prompts, logs, or reports.
global_rules.latency_and_tokens: Count all model prompts, responses, tool-selection turns, and repair turns.
global_rules.mock_label: Every adapted task must remain labelled adapted_mock_task.

package_interpretation: Three prompting packages, not a factorial isolation of zero-shot/few-shot and reasoning format. P2 contains three demonstrations; P3 is zero-shot ReAct-like and contains no demonstrations.
repetition_interpretation: Repeated executions under fixed decoding settings; not independent stochastic samples.
execution_policy: Sequential; one model at a time; no parallel GPU runs.
pilot_exposure_note: Four test tasks have prior exploratory A5000 pilot exposure. Prior pilot records are excluded from confirmatory result calculations; only new runs in the formal output file count.

excluded_tasks.L1-102: Exact duplicate goal/arguments of development task L1-100.
excluded_tasks.L1-084: Adapted mock task; optional second benchmark, excluded from primary set.
excluded_tasks.L2-001: Adapted mock task; optional second benchmark, excluded from primary set.

provenance_note: L3-1 and L3-2 are original API-Bank tasks with researcher-reconstructed tool arguments; preserve this provenance in reporting.
latency_and_token_scope: Include all model prompts, responses, tool-selection turns, repair turns, and few-shot demonstration context. Report task latency and end-to-end latency separately.
semantic_review: Task success requires separate semantic review of the final answer. Do not treat automatic tool-goal completion alone as final task success.
